source_binding.description: Tested working-tree source after initial field implementation and reviewed static-storage/native-scope/class-initialization corrections. Exact relevant bytes are frozen and hashed; a later final source commit is bound separately by the parent candidate collector.

scope: General portable no_std+alloc DEX Field discovery, metadata, access and typed getters. Shared static/instance storage ambiguities fail explicitly. No package branches, fabricated fields or external-game compatibility claim.

review_corrections.correction: Count actual same-name static declarations before active use. More than one fails API_UNAVAILABLE before initializing the owner; no aliased value is returned.
review_corrections.finding: Same-name static fields with distinct descriptors can alias the existing owner/name static map.
review_corrections.proof: An original javac class file changes only omega to alpha in a UTF8 constant. JVM and d8 accept identical same-name int/long fields; JVM observes int:41,long:97. Both Android DEX namespaces expose both declarations and reject the read without marking the owner initialized.

review_corrections.correction: A peer added actual owner admission, independent native/backend and callback-local allocation scopes, return/exception pinning and explicit unavailable foreign initialization waits. Field tests are rerun on those exact corrected sources.
review_corrections.finding: Real native DEX frames require owner-specific backend allocation scopes and must not borrow another owner class-initialization state.
review_corrections.validation: This receipt does not relabel peer commands as locally executed; see the linked source-bound receipt for its 12 execution, 5 Throwable and 4 dispatch tests and Clippy.

commands.command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 cargo test -p as-framework --features host --test reflection_fields --test class_forname --locked -- --test-threads=1
CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 cargo clippy -p as-framework --features host --lib --test reflection_fields --locked -- -D warnings

contract: Only actual declared DEX class-data fields establish reflected declarations. Bytecode field_id references do not manufacture fields; malformed declarations propagate typed parser/metadata errors.

Class.getDeclaredField searches own instance then static declarations; getField searches own public declarations, direct interfaces recursively, then superclass. Null names and missing fields throw real typed exceptions.
Field metadata exposes actual name, declaring Class, resolved type Class, low 16 access flags and independent accessibility override. Canonical Class and service-owned Field provenance is validated.

Generic get returns real references/null or exact primitive wrapper objects; typed getters use Java widening only. Instance reads validate null and assignability, then return real stored values or genuine unwritten defaults.

Static reads initialize the actual declaring owner; inherited reads do not initialize the requesting subclass. Existing Class.forName default-interface admission is reused, so unsupported required initialization is not skipped.

Access checks use actual DEX declaring class for the current real NativeHost owner; no backend means the single interpreter. No active caller for a nonpublic host read and unknown backend identity fail explicitly. Portable native DEX frames carry real ClassDef metadata and restore it after returns and exceptions; legacy std route is unchanged.

ART 26 receiver/static initialization precedes access/conversion checking. An initializer may reenter setAccessible on the same Field before access is checked; a GC/reentrancy test verifies the updated override and live metadata.

Field metadata is weak and bounded at 4096 records / 4 MiB estimated payload; active reads retain independent ticketed roots (64 scopes). Retained Fields exhaust the budget, and unreachable Field GC reclaims it.

api.fields: Real ClassData definitions with checked owner/type/storage flags. Referenced field IDs do not become declarations.
api.catalog: Only exact implemented instance descriptors are cataloged; inherited Member metadata and AccessibleObject access methods route to real Field state. Setters are not cataloged.

test_scenarios: Two different Java namespaces and manifest identities share the same runtime contracts, with 236 JVM comparisons and all 64 primitive widening pairs per namespace.
Real public static final String/int values, declaring class/type/name/modifier metadata, public interface/superclass discovery, no declared inheritance and no field_id-only fake definition.
Actual default/reference instance values, exact primitive wrappers and Float/Double values, reference identity and real typed null/wrong receiver/access/conversion failures.
Discovery does not initialize an owner; active static reads initialize once and failed initializers remain failed. Default-bearing-interface scheduling remains explicit unsupported.
Private actual-Dex-caller access, per-Field suppression, protected cross-package receiver checks and access-state reentry from clinit with GC.
Service-owned provenance, weak records, metadata budget exhaustion/reclaim, in-flight read roots and actual Class references across collection.
Real NativeHost DEX-frame declaring class and frame restoration after normal return or propagated exception; legacy std execution is unchanged.

Legal same-name static fields are present with distinct I/J descriptors in both DEX fixtures; reads are rejected before initialization. Hidden instance storage and unknown platform fields remain explicit unsupported.
limitations: Field writes, platform field catalogs, annotations/generic signatures and full reflection ecosystem are not implemented.
Hidden same-name instance fields and duplicate-name static fields require richer storage keys and are deliberately unavailable.

A public field read can proceed without a Java caller; nonpublic access with no actual caller or unknown native identity cannot silently succeed. Custom classloader provenance is not implemented by this layer.
Foreign class initialization waits are explicitly unavailable; the implementation does not pretend another thread completed its initializer.
Volatile ordering outside the VM lease, a production AArch64 JNI Field roundtrip, Android reference-device execution and Switch hardware were not established by these tests.
The old 17 production JNI / 6 GC regressions are retained in the initial receipt; current native-scope/owner checks are separately source-bound by the peer receipt.
No unchanged external game first screen is claimed.
